title: iPhone held by user-try, unused for 5 min while 2 jobs wait

messages.text:
user-try has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 14:13Z, lease taken by user-try). The limit is 5 min.
Queued for it: iphone-runner, cd-roll-ca.
user-try: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner user-try) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-desk-2): please make sure the phone is used.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
